beats.label: S1 · Enter Hannibal
beats.text: Jack recruits FBI empath Will Graham to catch a serial killer; new consultant Dr. Hannibal Lecter helps Will kill Garret Jacob Hobbs and save his daughter Abigail.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the trio (Will, Jack, Hannibal) and the founding wound — killing Hobbs — that everything else grows out of.

beats.label: S1 · The secret Copycat
beats.text: Hannibal secretly murders Cassie Boyle in the Shrike's style to guide Will's thinking, beginning his hidden project of shaping Will and studying his mind.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the engine of the whole series: Hannibal is not helping Will, he is sculpting him. Every later manipulation runs from this.

beats.label: S1 · Abigail's secret
beats.text: Abigail wakes and kills Nicholas Boyle in a panic. Hannibal helps her hide the body, tying her survival to keeping his secrets.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Abigail on Hannibal's leash, which is what makes her murder late in the season devastating rather than incidental.

beats.label: S1 · The Ripper unseen
beats.text: The Chesapeake Ripper resumes killing; Jack remains haunted by his lost trainee Miriam Lass. Hannibal's own psychiatrist Bedelia Du Maurier begins to sense what he is.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants three long threads at once — the Ripper as Hannibal, Miriam still alive somewhere, and Bedelia as the one witness who knows.

beats.label: S1 · Encephalitis hidden
beats.text: Will begins sleepwalking and blacking out. Hannibal learns Will has advancing encephalitis and murders neurologist Sutcliffe to keep the diagnosis from him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The mechanism of the frame. Hannibal is deliberately keeping Will sick so his own memory cannot be trusted.

beats.label: S1 · The frame closes
beats.text: Will finally realises Hannibal is the Copycat who tipped off Hobbs, but Hannibal has already killed Abigail, fed her ear to Will, and planted the evidence.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's hinge: Will sees the truth exactly when it becomes useless, because he has already been made to look guilty.

beats.label: S1 · Behind the glass
beats.text: Jack arrests Will for the Copycat murders, including Abigail's. He is committed to the Baltimore State Hospital while Hannibal walks free on the other side.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the entire opening act of season 2: Will locked up, Hannibal free, only one of them knowing what really happened.

cliffhanger.text: Will Graham is locked in the Baltimore State Hospital, framed as the Copycat killer and the man who murdered and ate Abigail Hobbs. Hannibal Lecter walks free, still consulting for the FBI, and no one but Will knows what he really is.
questions: Can Will convince anyone that Hannibal is the real killer?
How far will Hannibal go to keep Will contained and the frame intact?
Will Bedelia Du Maurier act on what she has begun to suspect?

characters.name: Will Graham
characters.line: FBI empath and profiler who killed Garret Jacob Hobbs, unravelled under hidden encephalitis, and has been framed for the Copycat murders.

characters.name: Hannibal Lecter
characters.line: Baltimore psychiatrist and secret cannibal who is the real Copycat and Chesapeake Ripper; has spent the season shaping Will and now watches him locked away.

characters.name: Jack Crawford
characters.line: Head of the FBI Behavioral Sciences unit; pushed Will past his limits and now believes his own protégé is a serial killer.

characters.name: Alana Bloom
characters.line: Academy psychiatrist who introduced Hannibal to the FBI; drawn to Will but keeps her distance because she thinks him unstable.

characters.name: Abigail Hobbs
characters.line: Daughter of the Minnesota Shrike who helped lure his victims; killed by Hannibal after he groomed her and hid her murder of Nicholas Boyle.

characters.name: Freddie Lounds
characters.line: Tabloid crime journalist who has painted Will as dangerous in print and circles every FBI case.

characters.name: Bedelia Du Maurier
characters.line: Hannibal's own psychiatrist, semi-retired after a patient tried to kill her; increasingly suspicious of what he really is.

beats.label: S2 · Framed and vowing revenge
beats.text: The season opens on Jack fighting Hannibal in his kitchen, three months away. From his cell, Will vows to expose Hannibal; only Alana half-believes him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's direction (Will vs Hannibal, ending in Jack in the kitchen) and confirms Alana as Will's only ally.

beats.label: S2 · Man in the eye
beats.text: Will helps the BAU on a killer sewing bodies into a human eye. Hannibal murders the killer and stitches him in, showing Will he can reach anyone.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reasserts Hannibal's reach even while Will is caged and starts the drumbeat of Hannibal cleaning up threats around Will.

beats.label: S2 · Katz, and exoneration
beats.text: Beverly Katz finds Hannibal's kills in his basement and is killed for it. Hannibal frames Chilton as the Ripper; a rescued Miriam Lass shoots Chilton, and Will walks free.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's pivot: Will is out, Chilton is disfigured and out of the way, and Hannibal has bought himself a clean slate with the FBI.

beats.label: S2 · Playing his game
beats.text: Will re-enters therapy with Hannibal, seemingly seduced. He kills Hannibal's patient Randall Tier in self-defence and lays the body on Hannibal's table, calling them even.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the ambiguous 'is Will falling or performing?' question the finale then answers.

beats.label: S2 · Vergers arrive
beats.text: Hannibal takes on Margot Verger, who wants her sadistic brother Mason dead. Will fakes Freddie Lounds's death and feeds her flesh to Hannibal to earn trust.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces both Vergers, who drive the front half of season 3, and shows Will crossing what looks like the point of no return.

beats.label: S2 · Mason broken
beats.text: Mason abducts Hannibal; Will frees him. Hannibal doses Mason, has him feed his own face to Will's dogs, and breaks his neck. Will tells Jack it has all been a sting.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Disfigures Mason (the shape he arrives in in season 3) and confirms Will's true allegiance right before the reveal to Hannibal.

beats.label: S2 · The kitchen
beats.text: Hannibal smells Freddie on Will and realises the sting. He guts Will, wounds Jack and Alana, reveals Abigail alive only to wound her too, and flees with Bedelia.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The wound each character carries into season 3, plus the reveal that Bedelia has chosen to go with him.

cliffhanger.text: Hannibal has walked away from a bloodbath in his own kitchen and disappeared into Europe with Bedelia at his side. Will, Jack, Alana, and a secretly-alive Abigail lie bleeding on his floor.
questions: Which of the four in the house survives what Hannibal did to them?
Where has Hannibal gone, and why has Bedelia chosen to follow?
If Will lives, does he still want to catch Hannibal, or find him?

characters.name: Will Graham
characters.line: Cleared of the Copycat murders; re-entered Hannibal's orbit as bait in a sting and was eviscerated for it when Hannibal smelled the trap.

characters.name: Hannibal Lecter
characters.line: Exposed as the Ripper to Will and to nobody else useful; slaughtered his way out of the sting and fled to Europe with Bedelia.

characters.name: Jack Crawford
characters.line: Ran the off-books sting with Will and lay bleeding in Hannibal's pantry when it collapsed.

characters.name: Alana Bloom
characters.line: Was briefly Hannibal's lover, was thrown through his window once she realised what he is.

characters.name: Bedelia Du Maurier
characters.line: Hannibal's former psychiatrist; has willingly boarded a plane to Europe with him for reasons she has not shared.

characters.name: Mason Verger
characters.line: Meat-packing heir and sadist; face fed to Will's dogs, neck broken by Hannibal, now paralysed and disfigured.

characters.name: Margot Verger
characters.line: Mason's sister; slept with Will to conceive a Verger heir before Mason had her sterilised, and remains under his control.

characters.name: Freddie Lounds
characters.line: Presumed murdered by Will; actually alive in FBI protection, having helped sell the sting.

characters.name: Frederick Chilton
characters.line: Shot in the face after Hannibal framed him as the Ripper; a disfigured, discredited survivor.

characters.name: Abigail Hobbs
characters.line: Secretly kept alive by Hannibal since her supposed death; revealed only to be wounded and abandoned in the massacre.

beats.label: S3 · Life as Roman Fell
beats.text: Hannibal and Bedelia surface in Florence living as the Fells, whose real bodies Hannibal made. He kills Fell's colleague Anthony Dimmond and displays the corpse as a heart.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the European chapter, Bedelia's chosen complicity, and the trail Will will follow.

beats.label: S3 · Will chases him
beats.text: Will has survived and learned Abigail died. He travels to Europe, meets Hannibal's silent retainer Chiyoh, and joins Florentine inspector Pazzi in the hunt.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Chiyoh — Hannibal's only real family connection — and puts Will and Pazzi on the same trail.

beats.label: S3 · Bounty on Hannibal
beats.text: Mason Verger, disfigured but alive, puts a bounty on Hannibal, with Alana as his new therapist. Pazzi tries to sell Hannibal to Mason and is disembowelled for it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Mason back into the season's antagonist and confirms Alana as an operator, not a victim, this time round.

beats.label: S3 · The farm
beats.text: Mason captures Hannibal and Will; Alana and Margot free Hannibal and drown Mason in his aquarium. Will tells Hannibal it is over, and Hannibal surrenders to the FBI.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Verger arc, ends the chase, and lands Hannibal in the cell that frames the whole back half.

beats.label: S3 · Three years later
beats.text: Hannibal has spent three years in Alana's hospital. Jack pulls a retired Will back in to catch Francis Dolarhyde, the killer slaughtering whole families each full moon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Red Dragon arc restarts the show on new terms: Will has a wife and son, and Hannibal is a caged consultant now.

beats.label: S3 · The Dragon and Hannibal
beats.text: Dolarhyde contacts Hannibal for guidance and is fed Will's home address. He attacks Will's wife and son, then bites off Chilton's lips and mails them to Hannibal.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Hannibal is running Dolarhyde the way he once ran Will, and it costs Will's family and Chilton his face.

beats.label: S3 · Off the cliff
beats.text: Will fakes Hannibal's escape as bait. They kill Dolarhyde together on a cliffside; Will calls it beautiful, embraces Hannibal, and pulls them both off the edge.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The finale image and the show's parting question — did Will finally choose Hannibal, and are either of them alive?

cliffhanger.text: Will and Hannibal have gone over the cliff together after killing the Red Dragon, and no bodies have been recovered. Bedelia sits alone at a table set for three, one of her own cooked legs on it, waiting to see who comes through the door.
questions: Did either of them survive the fall?
If both did, are they still together?
Who set that third place at Bedelia's table?

characters.name: Will Graham
characters.line: Came out of retirement to catch the Red Dragon, chose Hannibal one final time, and pulled them both off a cliff.

characters.name: Hannibal Lecter
characters.line: Surrendered to Alana's hospital after roughly a year in Europe, then vanished over a cliff with Will after killing the Dragon.

characters.name: Jack Crawford
characters.line: Widowed by Bella's cancer; pulled Will back into fieldwork one last time and lived to close the Hannibal case.

characters.name: Alana Bloom
characters.line: Now hospital administrator, married to Margot with a Verger heir; has spent three years as Hannibal's warden.

characters.name: Bedelia Du Maurier
characters.line: Fled Europe as Hannibal's companion, then testified against him; last seen at a table set for three with her own cooked leg on it.

characters.name: Francis Dolarhyde
characters.line: The Red Dragon; killed families each full moon and became fixated on Hannibal before Will and Hannibal killed him together.

characters.name: Reba McClane
characters.line: Blind woman Dolarhyde fell for; the reason he could not fully surrender to the Dragon, and the person he chose to spare.

characters.name: Chiyoh
characters.line: Hannibal's family retainer who guarded a caged man for decades; briefly Will's uneasy ally before disappearing again.

characters.name: Frederick Chilton
characters.line: Disfigured yet again, this time by Dolarhyde, who bit off his lips and burned him alive; he survived.

characters.name: Mason Verger
characters.line: Killed at his own farm by Margot and Alana after his final bid to eat Hannibal.
